name: City Council Study Session - City Council Goals - Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Study Session Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive

  WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 24, 2024 - 4:30 p.m.
  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:
 This meeting will be conducted in a hybrid model. Member of the public may join this meeting
 virtually or attend in-person in the Council Chambers.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at antoinette@wlv.org no later than
 12:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89819558081
  Webinar ID: 898 1955 8081
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16699009128,,89819558081# OR +16694449171,,89819558081#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 719 359 4580 OR +1 253 205 0468

 Virtual participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor or
 the meeting chairperson. The meeting host will announce when individuals wishing to
 speak must “raise their hand”, at which time they will be unmuted.

 In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
 modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
 services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
 distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
 public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
 hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
 Packets.
 CALL TO ORDER: 4:30 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Halpern, McSweeney, Honig, Mayor Pro Tem
  Davis, Mayor Pearl

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council on items not on the
printed agenda. Please observe the time limit of three minutes. Members of the public may offer comment
telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom teleconference service options as listed on Page
1 of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk prior
to the meeting starting.

STUDY SESSION:

1.  REVIEW OF CALENDAR YEAR 2023 CITY COUNCIL GOALS AND
  CONSIDERATION OF 2024 CITY COUNCIL GOALS - review the Status Report
  addressing current goals and adopt a subset of goals for Calendar Year 2024.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, January 18, 2024 at 5:30 p.m. on the City’s website and
in the Posting Board at City Hall.
  City Clerk
  January 18, 2024

 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas or
 www.wlv.org/agendacenter

 Signup for Agenda Posting Notifications for the new Agenda Center. The Agenda Center is a central
 location for all public meeting agendas. You select the categories for your notifications. Sign up using
 “Notify Me” https://www.wlv.org/List.aspx

 If any additional items are distributed to City Council less than 72 hours prior to the meeting, they are
 available in City Hall during normal business hours and posted on the City’s Website -
 https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

 Watch the City Council Meeting Video LIVE or to rewatch a prior meeting video, click “City Council
 Agendas, Minutes & Video” (http://westlakevillage.granicus.com/viewpublisher.php?view_id=8) City
 Council meetings can be seen live on WVTV Channel 10 or via web streaming on www.wlv.org
